agileRanger: Suppresses Opening Volley and Ranged Evasion while worn.
agileRogue: Suppresses Cunning Action and Uncanny Dodge while worn.
heavyRage: Heavy armor — ends your Rage (no fury bonuses while worn).
monkWeaponKeepsKit: Drilled into the forms — Ki, the flurry, and the stances keep their footing. The price: your empty hand's {die} +{edge} strikes are set aside for this arm's own steel.
monkWeaponStillsKit: Steel stills the forms — no Ki, no flurry, no stances while this is in hand, and the empty hand's {die} +{edge} goes with them. The empty hand asks for nothing.
fistsNotAnItem: The empty hand is not an item — it never leaves.
